_note: Youth Strategic Forum, Dubai 2026 — event rundown. Days 0 and 1 sourced from the client's Official Rundown PDF (YSF Dubai 2026 - Rundown.pdf, shared 2026-09-23). Day 2 detailed schedule not yet released by the client; Day 3 is check-out logistics.

days.label: September 22, 2026
days.title: Arrival & Networking
days.description: Delegates arrive and check into the hotel, gather for a welcome reception in the lobby, and set sail for a gala dinner cruise along Dubai's iconic skyline.

items.title: Hotel Check-in
items.description: Official check-in and settling into the forum hotel.

items.title: Welcome Reception
items.description: An introductory informal gathering for attendees to meet, mingle, and network in the hotel lobby before leaving for the Gala Dinner. This session establishes an open and welcoming environment, allowing participants to familiarise themselves with fellow delegates in a semi-formal setting. This marks the beginning of an intellectual journey where your unique perspectives will shape new paradigms for our shared economic future.

items.title: Gala Dinner — Dubai Cruise
items.description: An elegant evening cruise bringing delegates together for a gala dinner against the backdrop of Dubai's iconic skyline. The evening combines fine dining, cultural exchange, networking, and a memorable celebration of the YSF international community.

days.label: September 23, 2026
days.title: Main Event
days.description: A full day at the Mohammed Bin Rashid Library: a guided visit, the opening session with the Executive Director, and three deliberative sessions on sustainability, energy diplomacy, and cultural statecraft.

items.title: Breakfast at Hotel
items.description: Breakfast is served at the hotel between 07:00 and 09:00 ahead of departure.

items.title: Departure from Hotel
items.description: Delegates depart the hotel together for the Mohammed Bin Rashid Library.

items.title: Arrive at Mohammed Bin Rashid Library
items.description: Arrival and registration at the forum venue.

items.title: Guided Visit to the Mohammed Bin Rashid Library & Exhibition
items.description: A guided visit to the Mohammed Bin Rashid Library, Dubai's landmark cultural and knowledge institution and the official venue of YSF Dubai 2026. Delegates will explore its collections, architecture, and cultural spaces while engaging with Dubai's vision for knowledge, learning, and innovation.

items.title: Opening Session with Mr. Hafiz Hassan
items.description: An opening address by Mr. Hassan, Executive Director of CSCD, introducing the vision, purpose, and key objectives of YSF Dubai 2026. Delegates will be welcomed into the Forum and oriented to its themes, programme, and spirit of international exchange.

items.title: Coffee Break
items.description: A short coffee break before the first session.

items.title: Session with Najia Qazi — Sustainability & the Policy Sandbox
items.description: A hands-on workshop with Najia Qazi (Sustainability Consultant and Founder of Sustainable Narrative in the UAE) exploring how sustainability policies can move from ambition to implementation through a policy sandbox, where participants develop, test, and refine practical solutions to real-world sustainability challenges. Delegates will work across sectors to consider the People, Planet, Profit framework, balancing environmental impact, social value, and commercial viability while thinking through the policy choices needed to accelerate the transition toward a circular economy.

items.title: Lunch Break
items.description: Lunch is served for delegates at the venue.

items.title: Session with Dr. Farid Guliyev — Energy Policy & Climate Diplomacy
items.description: A deliberative session with Dr. Farid Guliyev (Assistant Professor of Political Science at the American University in Dubai) examining the implications of the Trump administration's energy policy for global climate governance and international cooperation. The session will explore the evolving relationship between energy security, domestic policy, climate commitments, and multilateral cooperation, and what these shifts may mean for the future of international climate diplomacy.

items.title: Session with Dr. Omar Bortolazzi — Art, Culture & Statecraft
items.description: A session with Dr. Omar Bortolazzi (Program Director, Master of Arts in International Affairs and Associate Professor of Political Science at American University Dubai) exploring how art and culture shape global influence and why youth needs to think like creative practitioners, not just policy analysts. From understanding soft power mechanisms to reimagining strategy through aesthetic production, this session delves deeper into the unexpected intersections between culture and statecraft.

items.title: Conclusion & Reflection Session
items.description: A closing reflection to bring together the day's threads and mark the end of Day 1.
